ctx.x: What other bands did you sort of play around with like your son when Tom didn't have a joke? Do you remember any other bands that hired you?

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I worked with Randy a long time, often and long. Mm-hmm. I worked with Chris Kelly. I worked with Buddy Petit. I worked with Jack Carey. I worked with Leslie Mayne. I worked with a fella called Big, One-Eyed Big, bass player. Mm-hmm. I worked with him. Oh, I worked with several bands around there, different places they'd go play in there. They'd sit on me there and have nothing but tones. I was in Idol, I stayed busy all the time.

What year did you say that was when you got into New Orleans? I went to New Orleans. I mean, when I got into New Orleans in 1980. Uh-huh. Yeah. But, trying to get some kind of picture of the style of clarinet you were playing then, I think Dick already asked you this. What you're playing now, the clarinet you're playing now, wasn't too much like what you were playing then? No. How was it different then?

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-05
items.q: Such as Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, Riddick, Riddick, Riddick, Punch Miller.

ctx.x: I was wondering about some of the bands you heard when you were a kid. When you were very young, before you even started playing. Do you remember any other than your father's band?

I mentioned the few I heard. As a matter of fact, I heard practically all of them because they used to come out there on that coast. Such as Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, Riddick, Riddick, Riddick, Punch Miller. Uh, a band used to come out there called the Maple Leaf Band. That was with, uh, Freddie Kepert. He used to lead that band. And all those boys used to come out there. I used to hear them. Matter of fact, they used to have what you call a trolley ride from Biloxi to Peskristad. It hooked five or six, uh,…
Who was in your daddy's band? Did he have a band of his own or what?

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: He had some nice trumpet players around here like Buddy Petit, Ricka, Rene, Chris Kelly, Lee Collins, Alvin Alcorn, Manny Mineta.

ctx.x: I never knew him, but I heard a lot of guys talk about him.

Well, he was a summons on him, Red Happy. He used to, he was with John Robichaud. Oh man. He was a fine drummer, this guy, Black Benny, was a fine drummer. He got killed, a poison or something. I think he got killed. He had some nice trumpet players around here like Buddy Petit, Ricka, Rene, Chris Kelly, Lee Collins, Alvin Alcorn, Manny Mineta.
What are these different guys specialize in?
